instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security
topic: Basic Risk, Residual Risk & Their Matrices

questions.question: What does the basic risk S express?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يعبّر عنه الخطر الأساسي S؟
options: The frequency of attacks over one year.
The risk before countermeasures are applied.
The risk left after countermeasures act.
The number of countermeasures in place.
options_ar: الخطر قبل تطبيق أي ضابط أمني.
options_en: The frequency of attacks over one year.
The risk before countermeasures are applied.
The risk left after countermeasures act.
The number of countermeasures in place.
questions.explanation: Basic risk is the risk of a threat as it stands, before any countermeasure is counted. Residual risk is what is left afterwards.
questions.explanation_ar: الخطر الأساسي هو خطر التهديد كما هو، قبل احتساب أي ضابط. والخطر المتبقي هو ما يبقى بعده.

questions.question: In the basic risk equation, what does F represent?
questions.question_ar: في معادلة الخطر الأساسي، ماذا يمثّل F؟
options: How long the asset stays offline after an attack.
How often attempts are made to exploit it.
How much damage a success would cause.
How many controls protect the asset.
options_ar: مدة بقاء الأصل متوقفاً بعد الهجوم.
options_en: How long the asset stays offline after an attack.
How often attempts are made to exploit it.
How much damage a success would cause.
How many controls protect the asset.
questions.explanation: F is the frequency of attempts to exploit the vulnerability, not the number of successes.
questions.explanation_ar: F هو تكرار محاولات استغلال الثغرة، لا عدد المحاولات الناجحة.

questions.question: In the basic risk equation, what does the factor K represent?
questions.question_ar: في معادلة الخطر الأساسية، ماذا يمثل العامل K؟
options: How many countermeasures are in place there.
How quickly the incident is detected and closed.
The damage a successful attempt would cause.
How often attempts are made against the asset.
options_ar: حجم الضرر لو نجحت المحاولة فعلاً.
كم مرة تُشنّ المحاولات ضد الأصل.
options_en: How many countermeasures are in place there.
How quickly the incident is detected and closed.
The damage a successful attempt would cause.
How often attempts are made against the asset.
questions.explanation: K is the consequences of one successful attempt: the size of the loss, not how often it happens.
questions.explanation_ar: K هو عواقب محاولة واحدة ناجحة: حجم الخسارة، لا تكرارها.

questions.question: Why is basic risk a product rather than a sum?
questions.question_ar: لماذا الخطر الأساسي حاصل ضرب لا مجموع؟
options: Because addition cannot handle three factors.
Because a product reads faster than a sum.
Because colours need two numbers to combine.
Because both must be high for risk to be high.
options_ar: لأن الجمع لا يستوعب ثلاثة عوامل.
لأن حاصل الضرب يُقرأ أسرع من الجمع.
لأن الخطر يعلى فقط إذا علا الاثنان.
options_en: Because addition cannot handle three factors.
Because a product reads faster than a sum.
Because colours need two numbers to combine.
Because both must be high for risk to be high.
questions.explanation: With a sum, a huge consequence would make the risk high even if the attempt almost never happens. A product keeps the risk low unless both factors rise.
questions.explanation_ar: بالمجموع، عاقبة ضخمة تجعل الخطر عالياً حتى لو كانت المحاولة نادرة جداً. وحاصل الضرب يُبقي الخطر منخفضاً إلا إذا علا العاملان معاً.

questions.question: Where does the red area of the risk matrix sit?
questions.question_ar: أين يقع المنطقة الحمراء في مصفوفة الخطر؟
options: Low frequency together with high consequences.
Low frequency and low consequences together.
High frequency and high consequences together.
High frequency together with low consequences.
options_en: Low frequency together with high consequences.
Low frequency and low consequences together.
High frequency and high consequences together.
High frequency together with low consequences.
questions.explanation: Red needs both axes high. One high and one low gives yellow, and both low gives green.
questions.explanation_ar: الأحمر يحتاج المحورين عاليين. واحد عالٍ وواحد منخفض يعطي أصفر، وكلاهما منخفض يعطي أخضر.

questions.question: Where does the red area of the residual risk matrix sit?
questions.question_ar: أين تقع المنطقة الحمراء في مصفوفة الخطر المتبقي؟
options: Low risk and low countermeasures together.
Low risk and high countermeasures together.
High risk and low countermeasures together.
High risk and high countermeasures together.
options_en: Low risk and low countermeasures together.
Low risk and high countermeasures together.
High risk and low countermeasures together.
High risk and high countermeasures together.
questions.explanation: The second matrix has risk and countermeasures as its axes, and it is mirror-symmetric to the first: red is high risk with few countermeasures.
questions.explanation_ar: المصفوفة الثانية محوراها الخطر والضوابط، وهي معكوسة تناظرياً للأولى: الأحمر خطر عالٍ مع ضوابط قليلة.

questions.question: What does the level of countermeasures M cover?
options: How many attacks the countermeasures blocked this year.
How many countermeasures there are and how effective.
How many countermeasures there are, and what they cost.
How effective the countermeasures are, and their age.
options_en: How many attacks the countermeasures blocked this year.
How many countermeasures there are and how effective.
How many countermeasures there are, and what they cost.
How effective the countermeasures are, and their age.
questions.explanation: M covers two things together: the number of countermeasures and their effectiveness. Those two are the influencing factors.
questions.explanation_ar: M يغطي شيئين معاً: عدد الضوابط ومدى فعاليتها. وهذان هما العاملان المؤثران.

questions.question: Why does M sit in the denominator of the residual equation?
questions.question_ar: لماذا يقع M في مقام معادلة الخطر المتبقي؟
options: Because countermeasures add to the total risk.
Because the equation needs a second variable.
Because countermeasures are measured in levels.
Because more countermeasures leave less risk.
options_ar: لأن الضوابط تضيف إلى الخطر الكلي.
لأن زيادة الضوابط تترك خطراً أقل.
options_en: Because countermeasures add to the total risk.
Because the equation needs a second variable.
Because countermeasures are measured in levels.
Because more countermeasures leave less risk.
questions.explanation: Division makes residual risk fall as M rises. If M were added or multiplied, stronger defences would raise the risk instead of lowering it.
questions.explanation_ar: القسمة تجعل الخطر المتبقي ينخفض كلما علا M. ولو كان M يُجمع أو يُضرب، لرفعت الدفاعات الأقوى الخطر بدل أن تخفضه.

questions.question: How do the two equations relate?
options: The first produces S, and the second consumes it.
The two are alternatives for the same quantity.
The second produces S, and the first consumes it.
They are independent and never share a term.
options_en: The first produces S, and the second consumes it.
The two are alternatives for the same quantity.
The second produces S, and the first consumes it.
They are independent and never share a term.
questions.explanation: They are two stages, not two choices: S is computed first, then fed into the residual equation as its numerator.
questions.explanation_ar: هما مرحلتان لا خياران: S يُحسب أولاً، ثم يدخل معادلة الخطر المتبقي كبسط لها.

questions.question: Which two quantities does basic risk multiply?
options: frequency and consequences
probability and controls
impact and recovery time
likelihood and asset value
options_en: frequency and consequences
probability and controls
impact and recovery time
likelihood and asset value
questions.explanation: The basic risk equation multiplies how often the threat occurs by how bad the consequences are.
questions.explanation_ar: معادلة الخطر الأساسي تضرب تكرار التهديد في سوء العواقب.

questions.question: What does residual risk represent?
options: what remains after controls
the risk before controls
the cost of the controls
the probability of a threat
options_en: what remains after controls
the risk before controls
the cost of the controls
the probability of a threat
questions.explanation: Residual risk is the exposure still left once the countermeasures have been applied.
questions.explanation_ar: الخطر المتبقي هو التعرّض الذي يبقى بعد تطبيق التدابير المضادة.

questions.question: Two departments face the same basic risk. A applies two effective controls, B applies one weak one. What follows?
questions.question_ar: قسمان يواجهان الخطر الأساسي نفسه. A يطبّق ضابطين فعّالين وB يطبّق ضابطاً ضعيفاً. ماذا ينتج؟
options: Department B has the lower residual risk.
Both departments have the same residual risk.
Residual risk does not depend on the controls.
Department A has the lower residual risk.
options_ar: القسم B عنده خطر متبقٍّ أقل من A.
الخطر المتبقي لا يعتمد على الضوابط.
القسم A عنده خطر متبقٍّ أقل من B.
options_en: Department B has the lower residual risk.
Both departments have the same residual risk.
Residual risk does not depend on the controls.
Department A has the lower residual risk.
questions.explanation: Same S, higher M, lower R. A has both more controls and better ones, so its residual risk is the smaller of the two.
questions.explanation_ar: نفس S، وM أعلى، إذن R أقل. A عنده ضوابط أكثر وأفضل، فخطره المتبقي أصغر.
